spans.s:
(ऋ) खेऌ r. 1st cl. (खेलति)
To shake, to tremble, to move.

f. (-ला)
Play, pastime, sport.
E.
खेल to shake, अङ् and टाप् affs.

n. (-नं)
Play, sport, pastime.
f. (-नी)
A piece or man at drafts, chess, &c.
E.
खेल to shake or move, affix ल्युट्.

f. (-लिः)
1 A song, a hymn.
2 An arrow.
3 The sun.
4 A bird.
5 Any animal.
E.
खेल to shake, कि aff.
